fields.description_en: L2. In the living room, furniture edges (e.g. sofa, table, chair, low cabinet) have sharp, hard corners or edges.

fields.description_zh: L3.客廳裡，有小電池、針、釦子、玻璃珠、小髮瓜、硬幣、瓶蓋等小物品放在幼兒能拿到的地方。（指約大人腰部以下的地）
fields.section: L.幼兒居家安全簡要檢核表
fields.description_en: L3. In the living room, small items such as batteries, needles, buttons, glass beads, small hairpins, coins, bottle caps, etc. are placed within a young child's reach. (Refers to roughly below adult waist height)

fields.description_zh: L4.客廳裡，有剪刀、指甲刀、刮鬍刀等尖、利物品或工具（如：起子、釘子、鋸子、打火機、火柴等）放在幼兒能拿到的地方。（指約大人腰部以下的地方）

fields.description_en: L4. In the living room, sharp items or tools such as scissors, nail clippers, razors (e.g. screwdrivers, nails, saws, lighters, matches) are placed within a young child's reach. (Refers to roughly below adult waist height)
